$comment: Product metadata for listing and catalogue use. Not read by the engine.

positioning.unit_of_planning: the individual habit, from cue to automatic
positioning.one_line: A habit system rather than a grid: assess what you already do, stack each new habit onto an existing one, track it for sixty-six days, and analyse the misses the day after they happen.

primary: People who have abandoned habit apps
Bullet journal users wanting a printable grid
Anyone rebuilding a routine after a disruption
Coaches working with clients on behaviour change

differentiators: 66-Day Habit Builder — sized to the measured median, not the twenty-one-day myth
Missed Habit Analysis — a never-miss-twice page filled the day after
Habit Stacking Planner with an explicit warning about anchoring to an unbuilt habit
Cue, Routine, Reward and Craving on one page per habit
Consistency Calendar — one habit across twelve months of thirty-one days
Success Rate pages that convert a streak into a percentage
Habit Assessment before any new habit is chosen
Four sizes, verified page and link parity
Undated — start on any day of any month

differs_from.005-goal-planner: 06 contains a three-page 31-day habit tracker as a supporting section beneath its goals. This is a standalone habit system: assessment, stacking, cue analysis, streak repair and long-form builders. Minor overlap, different product.
differs_from.012-goal-achievement-planner: 11 has a Habit Alignment page asking which goal each habit serves. This asks how the habit is built and kept.

compatibility.print: 100% scale, no bleed required, 100–120 gsm recommended. Print the 66-day builder at A4 or US Letter; the grid is tight at Half Letter.
